annotations.text:
1 · There is currently no way back in — no manifest, no service worker, no notification anywhere in src/ or functions/.
An install sheet, shown once after the third visit. Never on first open, when nobody has a reason to say yes.

2 · The app has no concept of "today", so nothing can ever be finished.
One target, reachable in about four minutes. The ring fills, then says continue if you want — never a wall.

3 · fluolingo:reward already does confetti and fanfare, and fires on 2 of 8 tracked moments.
Six more events — and vary the size, or the fanfare stops meaning anything.

4 · XP is awarded on every right answer and shown nowhere at the time.
A float that rises and fades, with the multiplier visibly doing the arithmetic: 40 x 1,5 = 60.

5 · bumpStreakToday increments silently; crossing to x1,5 shows nothing at all.
Celebrate the tier, colour the flame, and hand out one free freeze a fortnight — exam weeks happen.

6 · Today all five hero marks render in body-text ink.
Four take a role colour, all clearing 5,2:1 on paper. The fifth stays ink on purpose.

7 · Every reward in the economy is fixed-rate: 60 correct, 20 wrong, always.
A daily first-answer multiplier and a gilded card add variance without ever lowering the floor.

8 · Games and lesson runs end with a summary; most drill surfaces just stop.
The same receipt everywhere: what you earned, what improved, one thing to fix.

9 · The board is cohort-scoped correctly but cumulative, so the order is settled by week three.
A weekly reset puts everyone back in a race, and neighbours beat a top-50 list.

10 · The locker holds five accent colours — 150 gems total, then the currency stops meaning anything.
Covers, tab sets, desks, and one rotating item that leaves on Sunday.
